comment: The kept part of checks by scope, read by scripts/ci-scope.ts (code-factory METHOD Phase 2 step 8).
A pull request runs the heavy checks its change touches; the merge queue and main run everything.
A changed path under `scopable` puts in scope the areas of the named suites that import it or name
it; a path under `runsEverything`, or outside `scopable`, runs everything. Widen `scopable` only
with the queue's results to show it holds. `visualDrift` is what the visual drift job builds and reads.
